name: Staff of Blessed Relief
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 195
Aura faint conjuration CL 8th
Slot none; Price 7,200 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This simple wooden staff is given to young clergy when they first set out into the world to spread the charity of their faith. The staff allows use of the following spells:
Create water (1 charge)
Stabilize (1 charge)
Bless (2 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, bless, create water, stabilize; Cost 3,600 gp
